title: The Afghanistan Security Network
description: A multi-document investigation covering Taliban prisoner transfers and a series of security incidents in Afghanistan. The investigator must distinguish direct operational evidence from association, spokesperson attribution, and competing explanations.
question: Which candidate actor is most strongly supported by the available evidence as the central actor linking these Afghanistan security incidents, and what evidence weakens that theory?

unverified_evidence.title: Anonymous field rumor
unverified_evidence.text: An anonymous social-media post claims that one of the attacks was retaliation for the earlier Taliban prisoner handover. The post provides no named source, documentary support, or independent verification.
